title: 20 知义娶老婆了21 挽雪的命运
content_zh:
庶女的生存法则
如情养好伤后，又迷上了游泳，她觉得呢，如果她会游泳，就不会差点溺水，如果她会游泳，就不会欠李骁一个人情了。
如果她会游泳，肯定能把小腹处的赘肉给消去，如果她会游泳，肩膀就不会因时常绣花而酸痛了，如果她会游泳，发育不良的胸部一定能长大不少的。
想到这里，如情全身血液都沸腾了。
但是，山西湖泊很少，再来如情也不可能光天化日之下跑到外头游泳，不过，办法还是想出来的。包打听的玲珑还真不愧为这个称号，不出几日便给如情带来了一个好消息。
在大同靠北的一处山林里，那儿有一方天然温泉，泉水虽然浑浊，但水是活水，并且最重要的，水并不深，她下去拭过，水中心也才刚及胸膛，泡澡或是凫水都是不错的选择。
如情听得那个心动，恨不得插翅就飞过去游上三大圈。
正当如情绞尽脑汁想怎样瞒天过海外出去山中泡温泉时，京里传来了确切的消息，父亲方敬澜在京中正式与余家下了聘，知义向傅原请了半月的探亲假，火速去了京里成亲，并准备把新妇接到山西来，这就叫夫唱妇随。
本来如情也想回京参加兄长的婚事来着，可惜路途遥远，被知义给拒绝了。后来听闻知义娶妻，没有办筵席，没有宴客，就那样，冷冷清清地把余家姑娘迎娶了进门。如情先前还不明白对结婚异常重视的古代士族，为何会如此精简，后来才从周妈妈嘴里得知，余家老夫人逝去，余家姑娘得在百日内婚嫁，否则就要守三年的孝，为怕余家姑娘守孝守成老姑娘，余家这才急着与方家定下婚事。
如情恍然大悟，又连忙熬夜赶工准备给新嫂子准备礼物。知义的探亲假只有半月，转眼间，时间很快就过去了，在四月月底的时候，知义带着新妇果真回到了将军府。
为表对新妇的重视，挽雪与朝云亲自领着方府的下人，在将军府大门前，亲自恭迎主母的到来。
知义骑着高头大马，一身玄黑衣裳，身前身后数十骑亲兵护卫，后边跟着一辆石青帷饰三驾马车，及一长串的单匹马车。
想必新妇便在马车里头，朝云挽雪不待新妇下车，已伏身跪了下来，口中齐声唱喏。
知义下得马来，亲自掀了帷帘，一位头戴纱巾，身穿降紫色吉祥如意纹褙子滚二指宽的白绒压边，同色锦纱百合如意褂子，下身大红色绣吉祥如意百褶月华裙的年轻妇人，在婆子丫头的服侍下，下得了马车。
知义牵着新妇，让下人全都起了身，朝云挽雪起身后便向新夫人福了身子，口称奴婢。
新妇打量此二人，转头问知义，“此二人是……”
知义回答：“朝云，挽雪。在我屋里侍候的。”
新妇不再说话，四处顾盼了下，“哪一位是四妹妹呢？”
知义还未答话，朝云已回答道：“夫人，四姑娘已在后院里等着您呢。”
挽雪也笑着道，“夫人，四姑娘金枝玉叶，身份娇贵，一向大门不出二门不迈的，待夫人进了内院，便能见着四姑娘了。”

知义微皱了下眉，不过却未说什么，只是对新妇道：“走吧，你一路上也累了，先进屋去休息一番。相信四妹妹这时候已经准备妥当了。”
新妇温婉地笑了，“听说四妹妹一向善解人意，做事周到，妾身一直想见识一番。夫君，妾身真的想迫不及待见上四妹妹了。”
知义唇角含笑，“走吧，当心路滑。”然后抚着新妇进入大门，一路来到垂花门处，这才取了头上的面纱，交给身后的婆子，但朝云动作更快，连忙上前接下，“夫人，让我来。”
新妇看了她一眼，略作打量，温言笑道：“有劳了。”
朝云结巴地道：“侍候夫人，本是奴婢的份内之事，夫人可别这么客气。”
进入垂花门，果见一个身粉紫对襟圆领褙子，水红撒虞美人花亮缎粉紫镶边衣裳，头梳归整的弯月髻，耳饰滴珠型玉石耳坠的明丽少女已欣喜地上前两步，声音清脆如黄莺出谷，动作妍丽如行云流水，一时间，看得呆住。
“嫂子来了。”如情轻快上前，在余氏身前三步停下，冲余氏规整地行了个纳福礼，“如情见过嫂子。嫂子眉毛生得真好。”其实，这余氏长相也是端庄型的，白皙且圆润的一张脸，与何氏有得一拼，但余氏却又多了份温婉，看表相，应该是个善解人意，温柔可人的女人吧，配上知义，虽然有些逊色，不过也算相形得益了。
如情也不能夸她美，朝云挽雪都比她漂亮多了，夸她白呢？又白不过自己，于是只能夸她眉毛生得好。
余氏亲自扶起了如情，握着她的手，上下打量，眼里有着惊艳，“大家都在说，妹妹生得颜色最好，又善解人意，今日一见，果真名不虚传，唉，如今我可羡慕向家公子了。”
“嫂子羡慕他干嘛呀？”
“羡慕他能娶到你呗。”余氏伸出短胖指头，轻轻点了如情的额头。
如情跺脚，故作羞涩，“嫂子真坏，才进得门来就拿我取笑。”
余氏呵呵地笑着，“这哪是取笑呢？我可是实话实说呀，是不是呀，夫君？”
知义也跟着淡淡地笑了，见大家都杵在门口，便道：“先进去说话吧，杵在这也不大好。”
然后一行人又来到知义居住的玄竹院。
如情边走边道：“嫂子，知道你一路劳累辛苦了，所以，里头早已备了饭菜。嫂子在京城，可能还吃不惯这儿的饭食，所以妹子吩咐厨子尽量按着京里的口味来做，希望嫂子能喜欢。”
边说便边来到玄竹堂，果然红木海棠纹如意大圆桌上已摆好了饭菜，丫头们正在忙活着，见着知义等人，全恭身福了礼，余氏全一一打赏了。最后又拉过如情，给了一个沉甸甸的荷包，“妹妹，咱们就是一家人了，以后有不什么不好的地方，还请妹妹多加指教。”
content_en:
The survival rules of a concubine
After Ruqing recovered from her injury, she became obsessed with swimming again. She felt that if she could swim, she would not almost drown. If she could swim, she would not owe Li Xiao a favor.
If she can swim, she will definitely be able to get rid of the fat on her lower abdomen. If she can swim, her shoulders will not be sore from embroidery. If she can swim, her underdeveloped breasts will definitely grow a lot.
Thinking of this, Ruqing's blood boiled all over her body.
However, there are very few lakes in Shanxi, and it would be impossible for Ruqing to swim outside in broad daylight. However, she still figured out a way. Linglong, who Bao inquired about, was truly worthy of this title. Within a few days, she brought good news to Ruqing.
In a mountain forest to the north of Datong, there is a natural hot spring there. Although the spring water is turbid, the water is living water, and most importantly, the water is not deep. She went down to wipe it, and the center of the water was just up to her chest. Taking a bath or drinking water are both good choices.
When Ruqing heard that, she wished she could fly over and swim three big circles.
Just when Ruqing was racking her brains to think about how to escape overseas and go to the mountains to soak in hot springs, the exact news came from Beijing. Her father Fang Jinglan officially hired the Yu family in Beijing. Zhiyi asked Fu Yuan for half a month's family leave, and hurried to Beijing to get married, and prepared to bring the bride to Shanxi. This is called a husband and a wife.
Originally Ruqing wanted to return to Beijing to attend her brother's wedding, but unfortunately the journey was far away and Zhiyi refused. Later, I heard that Zhiyi was marrying a wife. There was no banquet or banquet, just like that, he just married the girl from the Yu family in a deserted manner. Ruqing didn't understand why the ancient gentry, who attached great importance to marriage, were so streamlined. Later, she learned from Zhou's mother that after the old lady of the Yu family passed away, the girls of the Yu family had to get married within a hundred days, otherwise they would have to observe filial piety for three years. For fear that the girls of the Yu family would become old girls if they kept their filial piety, the Yu family rushed to make a marriage arrangement with the Fang family.
Ruqing suddenly realized this and hurriedly stayed up late to prepare gifts for her new sister-in-law. Zhiyi's family leave was only half a month, and time passed quickly in the blink of an eye. At the end of April, Zhiyi returned to the General's Mansion with his bride.
To show their respect for the bride, Wan Xue and Chao Yun personally led the servants of Fang Mansion to welcome their mistress in front of the gate of General Mansion.
Zhiyi rode a tall horse, dressed in black clothes, and was guarded by dozens of horsemen and soldiers. Behind him was a troika with azure curtains, and a long series of single-horse carriages.
The bride must have been in the carriage. Before the bride could get out of the carriage, she already knelt down and sang in unison.
Zhiyi got off the horse and lifted the curtain himself. A young woman wearing a gauze scarf, wearing a purple and auspicious Ruyi pattern, a white velvet edge two fingers wide, a brocade and lily Ruyi gown of the same color, and a bright red pleated moonlight skirt embroidered with auspicious Ruyi patterns, got off the carriage under the service of her mother-in-law and maid.
Zhiyi took the bride in hand and asked all the servants to get up. After Chao Yun Wanxue got up, he blessed the new lady and called her slave.
The bride looked at the two people and turned to ask Zhiyi, "These two people are..."
Zhiyi replied: "Chaoyun, Wanxue. He is waiting in my house."
The bride stopped talking and looked around, "Which one is the fourth sister?"
Before Zhiyi could answer, Chaoyun had already replied: "Madam, the fourth girl is already waiting for you in the backyard."
Wan Xue also smiled and said, "Madam, the fourth girl has a noble status and never leaves the front door. When the madam enters the inner courtyard, she will be able to see the fourth girl."
Zhiyi frowned slightly, but didn't say anything. He just said to the bride: "Let's go. You are tired along the way. Go inside and have a rest. I believe the fourth sister is ready by now."
The bride smiled gently, "I heard that the fourth sister has always been considerate and considerate. I have always wanted to see her. Husband, I am reallyI can't wait to meet my fourth sister. "
Zhiyi said with a smile on his lips, "Let's go, be careful of slippery roads. Then he caressed the bride and entered the gate, all the way to the hanging flower gate, then took off the veil on her head and handed it to the mother-in-law behind her. But Chaoyun moved faster and hurriedly stepped forward to take it, "Madam, let me do it." "
The bride glanced at her, looked her over briefly, and said with a warm smile: "Thank you. "
Chaoyun stammered: "It is your duty to serve Madam, so please don't be so polite, Madam. "
Entering the hanging flower door, I saw a bright girl with a pink and purple double-breasted round-neck gown, bright red poppy flowers, bright satin pink and purple trimmed clothes, a neat crescent bun with her hair, and bead-shaped jade earrings. She took two steps forward happily. Her voice was as crisp as an oriole coming out of the valley, and her movements were as beautiful as flowing clouds and flowing water. For a moment, I was stunned.
"Sister-in-law is here. Ruqing stepped forward briskly, stopped three steps in front of Mrs. Yu, and bowed to Mrs. Yu neatly, "Ruqing has met my sister-in-law." My sister-in-law has really good eyebrows. "Actually, Mrs. Yu's appearance is also dignified. Her fair and round face is comparable to that of Mr. He, but Mrs. Yu is more gentle. Judging from her appearance, she should be a considerate, gentle and pleasant woman. With Zhiyi, although she is a little inferior, she can still be considered to be incomparable.
Ruqing can't praise her beauty. Chaoyun and Wanxue are much prettier than her. How about praising her for being white? She couldn't be fairer than myself, so I could only praise her for her eyebrows.
Mrs. Yu personally helped up Ruqing, held her hand, and looked her up and down, with amazement in her eyes, "Everyone is saying that my sister is the prettiest and considerate. When I saw her today, she really lived up to her reputation. Alas, now I envy Young Master Xiang. "
"Why does sister-in-law envy him? "
"I'm jealous that he can marry you. "Ms. Yu stretched out her short, fat fingers and lightly tapped Ruqing's forehead.
Ruqing stamped her feet, pretending to be shy, "Sister-in-law is so bad, she just made fun of me when she came in." "
Mrs. Yu chuckled, "How is this a joke? I'm telling the truth, right? Husband? "
Zhiyi also smiled faintly, and seeing everyone standing at the door, he said: "Go in and talk first, it's not good to stand here. "
Then the group came to Xuanzhuyuan where Zhiyi lived.
Ruqing said as she walked: "Sister-in-law, I know you have worked hard all the way, so food has been prepared inside. My sister-in-law is in the capital and may not be used to the food here, so I asked the cook to cook it according to the taste of the capital as much as possible, hoping that my sister-in-law will like it. "
As they talked, they came to Xuanzhu Hall, and sure enough, food had been placed on the big round table with red wood and begonia patterns, and the girls were busy. Seeing Zhiyi and others, they all bowed respectfully, and the Yu family all rewarded them one by one. Finally, he pulled Ruqing over and gave her a heavy purse, "Sister, we are a family. If there is anything wrong in the future, please give me more advice. "
